entries.role: Class of insect-like Byston Well mecha fielded by the Drake Army and Show's side.
entries.notes: 16 rows. Wikipedia and SRW wiki both use 'Aura Battler(s)'; ACE1 fan translation also 'Aura Battler'. Also appears as オーラバトラー隊 (Aura Battler squad). Example brief63016#16, brief63024#32.

entries.role: Life energy of Byston Well that powers aura machines; used alone in lines like オーラの力 / 悪しきオーラ / オーラ光.
entries.notes: Wikipedia: 'powered by a powerful energy called "aura" or "life energy"'. Lower-case in running text; capitalised only in fixed names (Aura Cannon, Aura Vulcan, Aura Slash...). オーラパワー in m6255#100 ('私のオーラパワーで') = 'aura power' as well. Examples m6161#94, m6251#121, m6251#207 (オーラ光 = aura light), brief63024#29.

entries.role: The aura energy of a pilot; also the name of a Dunbine-family ability that multiplies attack power for a while (Weapon 6).
entries.notes: 22 rows. Wikipedia uses 'Aura Power' (Show's Aura Power increases...); akurasu ACE2 lists Weapon 6 'Aura Power'; ACE3 fan translation 'Aura Power'. Read オーラりょく. Capitalise as the ability name (m6302#172, m6302#291 'ウェポン6:オーラ力'); in story text it is still the proper term (brief63024#31, brief63256#8, m6033#116).

entries.role: Defensive field of aura machines and aura ships; Weapon 4 of the Dunbine-family units (reduces damage for a time).
entries.notes: 7 rows. SRW wiki 'Aura Barrier'; akurasu ACE2 'Aura Barrier'; ACE3 and ACE1 'Aura Barrier'. Examples m6161#52 (Drake's battleship has the barrier up), m6302#196, m6302#280.

entries.role: Collective term for all aura-powered machines (Aura Battlers, aura ships) of the Drake Army.
entries.notes: 6 rows. No dedicated wiki page found on byston-well / SRW wikis (Byston Well wiki is a stub); ACE3 fan translation encyclopedia uses 'Aura Machine'. Literal and standard in fan usage. Examples brief63148#7, brief63256#9, brief63256#11.

entries.role: Only appears as オーラノヴァ砲, the main cannon of the aura battleship Goraon.
entries.notes: Always written オーラノヴァ砲 = 'Aura Nova Cannon' (SRW wiki Goraon armaments list: 'Aura Nova Cannon'). 6 rows, all in m6252: #56 'ゴラオンのオーラノヴァ砲ならば', #62, #63 ('オーラノヴァ砲、撃て!' = 'Fire the Aura Nova Cannon!').

entries.role: Aura-powered battleship; in ACE2 the description of the Gran-Garan/Goraon side ships exiled from Byston Well.
entries.notes: 1 row: menu3019#25 ('オーラ力によって稼動するため、オーラシップと呼ばれる'). SRW wiki mecha page calls Zelana / Bull Beggar 'An Aura Ship' (and 'Aura Battleship' for the big ones); ACE3 has オーラシップ砲 = 'Aura Ship Cannon'. No standalone page.

entries.role: Title given to surface-world (地上人) pilots summoned to Byston Well; also part of the series title 聖戦士ダンバイン.
entries.notes: 6 rows. Wikipedia: 聖戦士ダンバイン Seisenshi Danbain, lit. 'Holy Warrior Dunbine'. As a title in dialogue use 'Holy Warrior' (m6900#39 / m6903#39 '地上人の聖戦士など不要' = 'no need for a Holy Warrior from the surface world'). BUT the series name 聖戦士ダンバイン (menu3022#1) must be the official English title 'Aura Battler Dunbine' (ACE3 deployment_017 does the same). SRW wiki keeps the pilot skill romanised as 'seisenshi' - not suitable for dialogue.

entries.role: Nanajin's ability (auto-activates at low armor; also usable as a barrier) and the series title (menu3022#12).
entries.notes: Game never writes リーン alone except inside アイリーン (Irene Carrier); every real hit is リーンの翼. As series title use 'The Wings of Rean' (SRW wiki/Wikipedia page title); as the ability use 'Wings of Rean' (akurasu, ACE3). Examples m6302#227, #645 'アビリティ:リーンの翼', #648 'リーンの翼(バリア)' = 'Wings of Rean (Barrier)', menu3022#12.

entries.ja: ウィンゲルバインダー
entries.role: Weapon 4 of the A.Taul (Gablae's Heavy Metal): two arm-mounted binders launched by remote control.
entries.notes: NOT Dunbine/Rean: the tutorial row sits in the A.Taul weapon list (m6302#331, next to セイバーフロッガー). MAHQ A.Taul armament: 'winger binder x 2'; akurasu ACE2 A.Taul Weapon 5 'Winger Binder'. The katakana reads 'wingeru' but the established English is 'Winger Binder'. Tutorial m6302#160-164 then shortens it to バインダー ('the binder'). No ACE1/ACE3 precedent.

entries.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
entries.role: Ancient precursor civilisation; the found song/poem plates are judged to be Protoculture artefacts.
entries.notes: 15 rows. Macross wiki page title 'Protoculture'. Examples brief63027#20, brief63027#23 (プロトカルチャーたち = 'the Protoculture'), brief63192#9.

entries.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
entries.role: Space-jump (fold) drive of the Macross; Nadesico gets caught in the Macross space fold.
entries.notes: 16 rows. Macross wiki page 'Space Fold'; ACE3 renders フォールド as 'fold'. Game also writes スペースフォールド (brief63187#4) = 'space fold' and スペースフォールドシステム (brief63187#7) = 'space fold system'. 'フォールド目標' (brief63187#5) = 'fold target'. Lower-case in running text.

entries.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
entries.role: The Macross's fold jump (brief63187#4) / its fold system (brief63187#7).
entries.notes: Macross wiki page title 'Space Fold'. 2 rows.

entries.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
entries.role: Humanoid mode of the VF-1 Valkyrie (バトロイド形態 = Battroid mode).
entries.notes: 14 rows, all tutorial (m6302#207, #209, #212, #214). Macross wiki 'Battroid' redirects to Variable Fighter, which uses 'Battroid mode'; ACE3 'Battroid Mode'.

entries.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
entries.role: Intermediate (legged fighter) mode of the VF-1 Valkyrie.
entries.notes: 12 rows (m6302#207, #212, #213). Macross wiki writes it in caps, 'GERWALK mode'; ACE3 'GERWALK Mode'; akurasu 'Gerwalk'. Keep all caps (official acronym).

entries.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
entries.role: Jet-fighter mode of the VF-1 Valkyrie (ファイター形態 = Fighter mode).
entries.notes: Only the Valkyrie-mode uses (m6302#207, #209, #210 'ファイター形態は、戦闘機形態です', #212, #213) = 'Fighter mode' (Macross wiki, ACE3). AMBIGUOUS STRING: 21 rows contain ファイター, most inside モビルファイター (G Gundam 'Mobile Fighter', see that entry). Never replace blindly.

entries.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
entries.role: Zentradi exclamation of shock/awe at human culture.
entries.notes: 2 rows: m6261#204 'デブラ、デカルチャー!' and m6282#203 'おおお......デカルチャー!'. Macross wiki page title 'Deculture' (often rendered 'Yack deculture!' in the TV dub, but the wiki term is Deculture). デブラ in m6261#204 is Zentradi-speak as well; leave as 'Debra'? - unverified, owner check.

entries.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
entries.role: Short for Boddole Zer's fleet: ボドル基幹艦隊 (main fleet), ボドル艦隊 (fleet), ボドル旗艦 (flagship).
entries.notes: Macross wiki: commander 'Golg Boddole Zer', fleet 'Boddole Zer Main Fleet'. Game forms: ボドル基幹艦隊 (brief63026#13, brief63027#16) = 'Boddole Main Fleet'; ボドル艦隊迎撃戦 (brief63027#8-10) = 'Boddole Fleet' interception; ボドル旗艦 already in names.json ('Boddole Flagship', m6281#103); ボドル基艦 (m6283#201 '目標はボドル基艦!') looks like a typo of 基幹艦/旗艦 - render 'Boddole Flagship'/'Boddole's main ship' (owner check). ボドルザー (person) already in names.json.

entries.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
entries.role: Boddole Zer's main Zentradi fleet that the Macross and Nadesico attack.
entries.notes: Macross wiki infobox: affiliation 'Boddole Zer Main Fleet'. The game shortens the name to ボドル, so 'Boddole Main Fleet' (or full 'Boddole Zer Main Fleet' if space allows). brief63026#13, brief63027#16.

entries.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
entries.role: Same fleet, mission titles ボドル艦隊迎撃戦 I-III.
entries.notes: brief63027#8, #9, #10 (Intercept the Boddole Fleet).

entries.role: Nergal mass-produced mecha; used alone and in エステバリス隊 (Aestivalis squad/team).
entries.notes: 54 rows. Nadesico wiki page title 'Aestivalis'. Plural in English text: 'Aestivalises' is awkward; prefer 'the Aestivalis team/squad' for エステバリス隊 (brief63018#21, brief63113#8). Pilot-specific forms (エステバリス(アキト) etc.) are already in names.json.

entries.role: Jovian gate-ships that spawn enemy units; targets of missions like チューリップ掃討 / チューリップ排除.
entries.notes: 20 rows. Nadesico wiki page title is 'Dimensional Leap Gate', but text: 'Known as Chulips to Nergal Heavy Industries and United Earth'; the game uses the nickname, so 'Chulip'. ACE3 also 'Chulip'. Do NOT write 'Tulip'. Examples brief63003#8, brief63016#9, brief63043#7.

entries.role: Short form of Nergal Heavy Industries (ネルガル側, ネルガルの戦艦ナデシコ).
entries.notes: Nadesico wiki 'Nergal' redirects to 'Nergal Heavy Industries' (already in names.json as ネルガル重工). Short form appears in brief63009#17, brief63009#20.

entries.ja: ディストーションフィールド
entries.role: Nadesico's gravity-wave barrier; also the Aestivalis/Nadesico-unit defensive weapon in the tutorial.
entries.notes: 10 rows. Nadesico wiki ND-001 Nadesico: 'its distortion field'; ACE3 'Distortion Field' (capitalised as system name). Examples brief63187#10, m6103#77, m6302#202, m6302#428.

entries.role: Nadesico's main gravity cannon (dotless spelling).
entries.notes: Dotless form, 11 rows (brief63103#8, m6007#14, m6122#90). names.json has the dotted グラビティ・ブラスト = 'Gravity Blast' (only m6131#82). Nadesico wiki: 'gravity blast cannon'. ACE1 fan translation of the identical line m6007#14: 'fire the Gravity Blast'.

entries.role: Earth's name for the unknown Jovian enemy (actually the Jovian Federation, 木連).
entries.notes: 37 rows. Nadesico wiki: 'Jovian Federation (木連) or the Jovian Lizards (木星蜥蜴 Mokusei Tokage)'; Wikipedia 'Jovian Lizards'. Keep the plural. Examples brief63009#8 (木星蜥蜴掃討), brief63009#17, brief63015#14.

entries.role: Surname of Akito Tenkawa; used alone (テンカワ君, テンカワ機 = Tenkawa's unit).
entries.notes: 16 rows. Full name テンカワ・アキト already in names.json ('Akito Tenkawa'). テンカワ機 (brief63018#21, m6103#88) = 'Tenkawa's unit/Aestivalis'.

entries.role: Surname of Jiro Yamada (who calls himself Gai Daigoji); used alone (ヤマダさん).
entries.notes: 8 rows. ヤマダ・ジロウ already in names.json ('Jiro Yamada'); Nadesico wiki 'Jiro Yamada' redirects to 'Gai Daigoji'. Short form m6103#87 'ヤマダさん、勝手に発艦します'.

entries.role: Jovian 'new weapon' (micro black hole railgun) that the player must destroy (mission 新型兵器ナナフシ).
entries.notes: 24 rows (brief63015#2, #9, #10). No page on the Nadesico wiki or SRW wiki. ナナフシ = 'walking stick (insect)'; the ADV dub/robots.fandom call it the 'Walking-Stick'. Proposal: keep the romanisation 'Nanafushi' as a weapon name (like Chulip/Batta) - owner decision between 'Nanafushi' and 'Walking Stick'. No ACE1/ACE3 precedent.

entries.role: Japanese port city where the Nadesico is docked/launched (サセボドック, mission サセボ攻防戦).
entries.notes: 12 rows. Nadesico wiki 'Japan' page: section 'Sasebo (佐世保)'. サセボドック (brief63016#13) = 'Sasebo Dock'. brief63009#20, brief63016#2.

entries.role: Appears only in developer comment rows (※ソーラレイ防衛戦 喧騒感演出用) of the Solar System defense mission.
entries.notes: 6 rows, all m6082#301-309 developer notes; the actual mission is about the Solar System (ソーラ・システム, already in names.json). Gundam wiki page 'Solar Ray'. These rows are probably never shown; translate literally ('Solar Ray defense - ambient chatter 1').

entries.role: Giganos Empire's lunar railgun used to launch asteroids at Earth (missions マスドライバー破壊).
entries.notes: 18 rows, all Dragonar context (brief63008#9, #28, #29). Gundam wiki page title 'Mass Driver' (general term); ACE1 fan translation 'mass driver' (lower-case). Capitalise only in mission titles ('Destroy the Mass Driver').

entries.role: Sazabi's remote psycommu weapon (Weapon 6); ν Gundam's version is フィン・ファンネル (Fin Funnel).
entries.notes: 9 rows (m6302#247, #265, #556, menu3062#10). No standalone Gundam wiki page ('Funnel' missing); Psycommu page uses 'funnels'; akurasu ACE2 'Funnel' / 'Fin Funnel'; ACE3 'Funnels'. Use singular 'Funnel' for the weapon name, plural in prose.

entries.role: Large mobile weapon; in ACE2 it is Gato's Neue Ziel (大型モビルアーマー, missions モビルアーマー排除).
entries.notes: 10 rows (brief63007#8, brief63063#6, brief63065#8, m6082#80). Gundam wiki 'Mobile Armor' redirects to 'Mobile Weapon' which uses 'mobile armor'. Lower-case like 'mobile suit' in terms.json; capitalise in mission titles. American spelling 'armor'.

entries.role: Anavel Gato's epithet. ソロモン never appears alone in ACE2.
entries.notes: m6022#92, m6022#112; m6022#213 'ソロモンの!' (shortened address = 'Solomon's Nightmare!'/'You, of Solomon!'). Gundam wiki Anavel Gato infobox: 'Nightmare of Solomon'; ACE3 same.

entries.role: Bright Noa's flagship, dotless spelling used in m6900.
entries.notes: Dotless form 6 rows, only in m6900 (#31 'よし、各機ラーカイラムに戻れ', #44, #56). names.json has the dotted ラー・カイラム = 'Ra Cailum'.

entries.role: Zeon remnant base in an African mine (キンバライド基地, キンバライド鉱山).
entries.notes: 7 rows. Gundam wiki 'Kimbareid Forces' (キンバライド部隊), location 'Kimbareid Base'. NOT 'Kimberide'/'Kimberlite'. キンバライド基地攻防戦 (brief63003#2) = 'Battle for Kimbareid Base'; キンバライド鉱山 (brief63045#6) = 'Kimbareid mine'.

entries.role: Psychically evolved human; said of Amuro (m6022#149) and Kou (m6033#103).
entries.notes: 2 rows. Gundam wiki page title 'Newtype' (capital N, one word).

entries.role: Radar-jamming particle scattered by Zeon forces (ミノフスキー粒子の散布!).
entries.notes: 3 rows (m6012#78, m6281#104, menu3019#43). Already in terms.json as 'Minovsky particles' (not in names.json); Gundam wiki: 'Minovsky particle(s)'. Consistent - keep.

entries.role: God Gundam's power-up state, triggered when Domon's fighting spirit gauge peaks (tutorial m6302#179-183).
entries.notes: 9 rows, all God Gundam; it is the G Gundam system, not an ACE2 original. Gundam wiki 'Hyper Mode' (section of Future Century technology; God Gundam modes 'Normal Mode, Hyper Mode'); akurasu and ACE3 'Hyper Mode'.

entries.role: The G Gundam tournament; announcer catchphrase ガンダムファイト!! レディーーー、ゴォーーー!!
entries.notes: 2 rows: m6093#172 = 'Gundam Fight! Ready... GO!' (classic dub line), menu3019#51 (ガンダムファイト専用に開発された = 'built for the Gundam Fight'). No standalone wiki page; Gundam wiki series page uses 'Gundam Fight'.

entries.role: God Gundam's higher state (明鏡止水モード) reached when Domon's heart attains a serene mind.
entries.notes: 12 rows (m6302#185-188). Gundam wiki uses the romanisation 'Meikyo Shisui' (Domon Kasshu page; 'Meikyō Shisui Ver.' toy names); ACE3 'Meikyo Shisui'; akurasu 'Meikyō Shishui Mode' (typo). Use ASCII 'Meikyo Shisui Mode' (no macron - 1-byte ASCII rule). In the prose line m6302#185 (心が明鏡止水の境地に到達した時) a gloss like 'a serene state of mind (Meikyo Shisui)' may read better - owner choice.

entries.role: G Gundam term for Gundam Fight mecha (Devil Gundam, Master Gundam...).
entries.notes: 5 rows (brief63178#14, brief63280#5, m6112#83). Gundam wiki 'Mobile Fighter' redirects to Mobile Weapon. Added because it shares the string ファイター with the Valkyrie mode - do not confuse.

entries.series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
entries.role: Gundam Deathscythe Hell's jamming device (Weapon 5): evades enemy lock-on for a time, drains vernier.
entries.notes: NOT Dragonar: m6302#536 is in the Deathscythe Hell list (ビームシザース投げ, アクティブクローク). akurasu ACE2 Deathscythe 'Hyper Jammer'; ACE1 fan translation 'Hyper Jammer'. m6302#273-276.

entries.role: Marshal Iskander Guiltorre, leader of the Giganos Empire, assassinated in the story.
entries.notes: Standalone surname, 9 rows (brief63227#6, brief63228#4 'ギルトール元帥暗殺事件'). names.json already has ギルトール元帥 = 'Marshal Guiltorre'; Dragonar wiki page 'Iskander Guiltorre'.

entries.role: Collective name for the Dragonar D-series prototypes, quoted from the military manual.
entries.notes: 1 row: m6021#69 'D兵器...軍の教則書にあったあれか...' (game writes ASCII D, NFKC-equal to Ｄ兵器). No wiki term for the group; the Dragonar wiki uses 'D-1/D-2/D-3' and 'Dragonar'. ACE3 provisional 'D Weapons'. Proposal 'D-weapons' (or 'D-Series weapons'); owner decision.

entries.role: Atmospheric flight unit fitted to the Dragonars (ドラグナー1型(リフター装備)).
entries.notes: 7 rows (menu3000#100, #103, #105, menu3019#44, menu3025#100). Dragonar wiki: 'XDFU-01 Dragonar-1 Lifter', 'Lifter Module'; akurasu 'Dragonar-1 (Lifter Unit)'; ACE3 'Dragonar-1 (Lifter)'.

entries.role: Neue Ziel's wired claw arms, fired from the main arms (有線クローアーム = Wired Claw Arm).
entries.notes: 10 rows (m6302#166-170 tutorial, #584-585 '有線クローアーム' / '(ホールド)'). Gundam wiki Neue Ziel armament 'Wired Claw Arm'; akurasu 'Wired Claw Arm'. Capitalise as weapon name 'Claw Arm'. Not Dragonar.

entries.role: Shikitai (死鬼隊) custom MF of the Grados army, enemy in m6221 ('行け、エルダール!').
entries.notes: 8 rows (m6221#91, #311-316 developer link notes, menu3061#175). MAHQ: 'MF-ED-52U El Darr'. No SRW-wiki/akurasu entry. m6221#92 'そいつはドリルに注意しろ!' (snake drills).

entries.role: Shikitai custom MF of the Grados army (m6221 '行け、ダンコフ!').
entries.notes: 8 rows (m6221#101, #317-322, menu3061#176). MAHQ: 'MF-DK-61U Dankova'. The katakana suggests 'Dancoff'; MAHQ (the only English source found) says Dankova - owner may prefer to confirm.

entries.role: Shikitai custom MF of the Grados army (m6221 '行け、ガッシュラン!').
entries.notes: 8 rows (m6221#111, #323-328, menu3061#177). MAHQ: 'MF-GL-73U Gashlan'. m6221#112 '左腕のコーンに気をつけろ!'.

entries.role: Poseidal's life-energy system: heals armor (Aug's Weapon 4, akurasu); Poseidal also uses it to brainwash the commander of his Imperial Guard (menu3019#38).
entries.notes: 7 rows (brief63190#10, m6181#154 'バイオリレーションシステム' = 'Bio-Relation System', m6302#257, #316, menu3019#38). SRW wiki: 'the mysterious power bio-relation'; akurasu 'Bio Relation'; ACE1 fan translation 'Bio-Relation' / 'Bio-Relation System'. Use ACE1's hyphenated form.

entries.role: Standard Heavy Metal launcher weapon (also ダブルパワーランチャー = Double Power Launcher).
entries.notes: 4 rows (m6302#309, #314). akurasu ACE2 'Power Launcher'/'Double Power Launcher'; ACE1 identical.

entries.role: L-Gaim Mk-II / Novel D.Sserd main cannon (バスターランチャー(フルパワー) = full power).
entries.notes: 4 rows (m6302#304, menu3046#72). MAHQ 'buster launcher'; SRW wiki 'Buster Launcher'; akurasu and ACE1 same.

entries.role: Dotless form: the binary-star system Daba and Poseidal's army come from.
entries.notes: 7 rows (brief63180#4, brief63244#5, #6). The dotted ペンタゴナ・ワールド is in research/ace2_batch_terms.json as 'Pentagona World'; ペンタゴナ = 'Pentagona' in names.json. SRW wiki uses 'the Pentagona System' and 'the Pentagona world'. Keep 'Pentagona World' for consistency.

entries.role: Shoulder/arm weapon-pod of Heavy Metals; short for ウィンゲルバインダー / ラウンドバインダー / サーカスバインダー.
entries.notes: 14 rows. Alone it is the shortened 'binder' of the Winger Binder (m6302#162-164). Only other compound in ACE2: ラウンドバインダー 'Round Binder' (m6302#315, ACE1). Other compounds seen elsewhere: ラウンドバインダー 'Round Binder' (ACE1), サーカスバインダー 'Circus Binder' (akurasu).

entries.role: Organic mecha born from Orphan plates (Grand Chers and Brains).
entries.notes: Dotless form, 11 rows (brief63024#25, #31, #32, #33). Dotted アンチ・ボディ = 'Antibody' in research/ace2_batch_terms.json. Wikipedia 'Antibodies'; ACE1 'Antibodies'. Plural 'Antibodies'.

entries.role: Short for Brain Powerd units (ブレンたち, ブレンパワード隊).
entries.notes: 44 rows total but most are inside names (ユウ・ブレン 'Yuu Brain', ヒメ・ブレン 'Hime Brain', ネリー・ブレン, ブレンパワード 'Brain Powerd'). Standalone: brief63024#21 'ブレンたちが勝手に動き出し' = 'the Brains moved on their own'. Compounds: ブレンブレード 'Brain Blade', ブレンバー 'Brain Bar' (ACE3). Spelled 'Brain' per series title (not 'Bren').

entries.role: Orphan's disc plates sought by the Reclaimers; ALSO (crossover) inscribed plates carrying a Zentradi/Protoculture song.
entries.notes: 25 standalone rows, two meanings: (1) Brain Powerd Orphan plates (brief63002#9 プレート回収阻止, brief63039#7-10, m6032#51-202, m6010#33-36) - Wikipedia 'Orphan's disc plates'; (2) ACE2 crossover: the 2nd plate found in Orphan with a poem, the plate Minmay brought from Britai's ship with a song, plate with Zentradi script (brief63026#15, brief63027#19-28, brief63192#7-8, m6261#124) - Macross wiki DYRL: Boddole Zer's 'ancient music plate'. 'plate' fits both. メモリープレート (brief63296#9, menu3018#61) = 'Memory Plate' (no wiki source; literal). オーガニック(・)プレート = 'Organic Plate'.

entries.ja: オーガニックプレート
entries.role: Dotless form of オーガニック・プレート (plate the Reclaimers collect).
entries.notes: 1 row: m6032#201 '敵はオーガニックプレートを回収中です'. Dotted form already 'Organic Plate' (ace2_batch_terms); ACE1 'Organic Plate'.

entries.role: Dotless form of バロン・ズゥ: Jonathan's/Quincy's powerful Antibody (also 巨大バロンズゥ).
entries.notes: 17 rows (m6252#5 'バロンズゥの撃破', m6253#205 '姉さんのバロンズゥが...'). Compounds ジョナサン・バロンズゥ / クインシィ・バロンズゥ already in names.json. akurasu and ACE3 'Baronz'; ACE1 used 'Baronzu' (f201) - do not follow.

entries.role: Brain Powerd term for an Antibody being 'born' from an Orphan plate.
entries.notes: 2 rows: menu3019#45 'オーガニック・プレートからリバイバル(再生)する機体' and m6254#51 'リバイバルはしなかった!'. Wikipedia: a disc plate 'revives into a unique Antibody'. Verb form 'revive' in prose; noun 'revival'. No dedicated wiki page.

entries.role: Brain energy in weapon names: チャクラシールド (Chakra Shield), チャクラ光 (Chakra Light), チャクラ光一斉射撃, チャクラフラッシュ.
entries.notes: 8 rows (m6302#199, #399, #415). akurasu ACE2: 'Chakra Shield', 'Chakra Light', 'Chakra Light All Fire', 'Chakra Flash'; ACE3: 'Chakra Shield', 'Chakra Light', 'Chakra Flash'. チャクラ光一斉射撃: akurasu 'Chakra Light All Fire' - consider 'Chakra Light Barrage' (owner).

entries.role: Gun Ark's power core that becomes unstable at MAX output (Op 01 story).
entries.notes: 6 rows (brief63029#15, m6011#122, m6012#101). Generic technical term; no wiki/ACE3 precedent. Lower-case in prose.
